upper_bound_event: There exists any one of two configurations at any of four checkpoints whose sampled-coarse seed-17 ratio improves by at least 20 percent in every phase with baseline conditional-MC interval excluding one. Drop any phase requiring the joint-dependence alternative. Ignore second seed, true-coarse mode, adjacent stability, joint scores, marginal and coverage guardrails, MC significance and actual checkpoint selector. This is a superset of full advancement; if no phase has an eligible ratio this screen is inapplicable.
decision: Reject sensitivity only if a simultaneous one-sided Hoeffding upper bound for this optimistic event is below 0.8 at the registered 0.2 effect in a declared law. Otherwise unresolved and run the complete gate. Never pass from this screen.
null_note: No-effect frequencies are false-advancement UPPER bounds for the relaxed event, not the complete rule's false-positive rate. A screen rejection needs no assumed independence of cores or checkpoint tests.
synthetic_scope: New independent phase truths, whole-phase correlated summary covariance from saved draws, shared truths across every candidate/checkpoint, paired finite-M innovations. No new Abacus prediction or empirical population power claim.
secondary_note: Use the saved class-fraction covariance in a separate declared Gaussian summary surrogate, not continuous-summary covariance or a multinomial independence assumption. Fractions are not primary.
